title: ～限りだ (〜kagiri da)
shortExplanation: Expresses an extreme degree of emotion or reaction; 'I feel so ~', 'as ~ as can be'.
longExplanation: The ～限りだ structure is often used with adjectives describing the speaker's emotion, highlighting how strongly the speaker feels. Translations often include 'I’m as ~ as can be,' 'I feel so ~.'
formation: い-Adjective + 限りだ, な-Adjective + な/である + 限りだ, Noun + の + 限りだ

examples.jp: 彼女が急に辞めてしまった。驚きの限りだ。
examples.romaji: Kanojo ga kyuu ni yamete shimatta. Odoroki no kagiri da.
examples.en: She suddenly quit. I'm as shocked as can be.

examples.jp: 息子が成功した。嬉しい限りだ。
examples.romaji: Musuko ga seikou shita. Ureshii kagiri da.
examples.en: My son succeeded. I'm so happy.

examples.jp: こんなに綺麗な花が見られるなんて、幸せの限りだ。
examples.romaji: Konna ni kirei na hana ga mirareru nante, shiawase no kagiri da.
examples.en: I'm as happy as can be to see such beautiful flowers.

examples.jp: 試験に合格できて、ほっとした限りだ。
examples.romaji: Shiken ni goukaku dekite, hotto shita kagiri da.
examples.en: I passed the exam—what a relief!
